title: Periods Taken Ahead of the Arrears on a ShieldCare Plan
content:
Where premium on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is brought back into order, periods ahead of
the arrears may be taken with it. The number is fixed by how much cover the plan has left to run and
by whether a claim has lately been decided on it.

**The cover left to run** is counted in whole months from today to the plan's coverage end day.

| What the records show | The periods taken ahead of the arrears |
| --- | --- |
| the plan has more than 2 years of cover left to run, and no claim stands decided on it inside the last 3 months | 2 periods |
| the plan has more than 2 years of cover left to run, and a claim stands decided on it inside the last 3 months | 1 period |
| every other plan | no period ahead of the arrears is taken with the settlement |

### Both sides of the cover threshold

More than 2 years of cover left to run means more than 24 whole months: a plan with exactly 24 whole
months left does not clear the threshold and takes no period ahead, whatever its claim history, while
a plan with 25 whole months left does clear it. Inside the threshold, a single claim decided in the
last 3 months is enough to bring the number down from 2 periods to 1.

### Cases on hypothetical records

| Whole months of cover left | Claims decided in the last 3 months | Periods taken ahead |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 8 | 2 | none |
| 24 | 0 | none |
| 33 | 1 | 1 |
| 33 | 0 | 2 |
